sentences.text: The sanction-letter wording states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the amount prepaid.
For Rs 10,00,000 prepaid, the charge is {{calc:1}}.
The bank documents do not all match, because one home-loan agreement says 2%, a copy says 3%, and the key facts statement says pre-payment / foreclosure charges are Nil.

missing.searched: searched the provided bank documents and RBI/UCB rule findings for a governing pre-payment charge rule for this case; the rule findings say the RBI pre-payment-charge directions are no longer in force and the UCB applicability findings are unknown for this case.
